description: The lighter's name other users see on a lamp, decided at the moment of lighting and never changed afterwards. The account's full name is never used.

inputs.dharma_name: the lighter's dharma name at the moment of lighting; null or empty when none
inputs.hide_name: true when the lighter chose to hide their name

output.displayed_name: the name or the anonymous label

cases.name: hidden name shows Vô danh even when a dharma name exists
no dharma name shows Vô danh
empty dharma name shows Vô danh
no dharma name and hidden shows Vô danh
